hypothesis: Lipid nanoparticles can effectively deliver modified nucleoside-containing mRNA to cells, reducing RNA immunogenicity and triggering a controlled immune response.
prediction: The use of lipid nanoparticles to deliver modified nucleoside-containing mRNA will result in a 30-50% reduction in immune response markers (e.g., cytokine levels) compared to conventional mRNA delivery methods.
measurement_method: ELISA or flow cytometry to measure cytokine levels and immune cell activation
falsification_condition: If the use of lipid nanoparticles to deliver modified nucleoside-containing mRNA results in an increase in immune response markers or no significant difference compared to conventional mRNA delivery methods, this prediction would be falsified.
